title: The Willful Neglect of Our Shepherds & Pastors

sense.text:
Deuteronomy 28:64: Deuteronomy 28:64 and give me 68. I want those two verses. I'm gonna be quick because like I said, I got to get into my stuff. Who did this happen to? The 12 tribes of Israel. The Israelites. That's who Moses was speaking to on Mount Sinai. When you read Deuteronomy 1:1, it was the Israelites that Moses was speaking to. So, the identity of the 12 tribes of Israel is in the Bible.

And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people: The point that Deacon brought out, which was absolutely on point. The Lord said that he will scatter the 12 tribes of Israel where? Among all people. Among all nations. Among all nations. The point that Deacon brought out is that everywhere you go, you could find black and Hispanic people in a messed up condition. No matter where you go on this planet Earth, you don't find that with other people. You don't find a quote unquote Arab ghetto. You don't find a so-called Chinese ghetto. You don't find a Japanese ghetto all over the planet Earth. How the hell you going to disregard the Bible when everywhere you go, you find our people in a messed up condition everywhere? So that fits what we reading in the Bible. Read that again.

From the one end of the earth even unto the other: Even unto the other. So that's the whole planet earth that 12 tribes of Israel are scattered. So who are the Israelites? The ones that you see fitting the curses of the Bible. There's no getting away from that at all. That's what the Bible says. You'd be crazy to walk away saying that, oh the Bible is this, that Bible is that. You better find out what this Bible is talking about and you better find out fast and stay with it. Read it again.

And the Lord shall scatter thee: The "thee" is the 12 tribes of Israel. He shall scatter us among the nations. Go ahead.

And there thou shalt serve other gods: That's the religious outpost. And there thou shalt serve other religions. Other gods that got nothing to do with the Bible, that got nothing to do with us. Lies. Read.

Which neither thou nor thy fathers have known: Our people are all over the planet earth stuck and encrusted in these lies, in these demonic philosophies. That's our people that fit that bill. So there's no getting out of it.

Even wood and stone: Even Christianity and Islam, all lies. That's got nothing to do with the 12 tribes of Israel. Period.

precepts.why: That's who Moses was speaking to on Mount Sinai. When you read Deuteronomy 1:1, it was the Israelites that Moses was speaking to. So, the identity of the 12 tribes of Israel is in the Bible.

sense.text:
And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt: The "thee" is the same people that Moses was talking to, the 12 tribes of Israel. And read it again.

And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again: And the Lord shall bring the 12 tribes of Israel into bondage again. That's why it's using the word Egypt there, because we just came out of ancient Egypt when you read the second book of the Bible, which is Exodus. Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy. That's the chronology of how Israel traveled coming out of Egypt. Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy. Those are the first five books. And in terms of history, chronologically it's recorded that way. So the second book was when we came out of Egypt. Hence the word Exodus, meaning to exit. To come out, exit. Exodus. That's the root of the word when you look it up. Okay. So now you talking about us coming out. We made our exit, our exodus out of Egypt. That was the second book. Now read that verse again in the fifth book.

Into Egypt again: Saying "again" because we were going to go back into those same conditions if we broke the commandments of God. Why is it that the preachers ain't saying this? There's a willful blindness and a willful deception of them not wanting to deal with the truth about who the people are that they're supposed to be over, that they're supposed to be shepherds over. Read it one more time and let's keep it moving.

With ships: How are we going to get to this bondage? With ships. With ships. The word Egypt means bondage. Literally. Literally means bondage. Could we find that thing? The Egypt thing. The Mizraim. Could we show that so they'll know exactly what I'm talking about? For the new brothers and sisters that's following today. See if you can find it real quick cuz like I said, I'mma keep it moving. Do y'all have it? Put it up there.

Into Egypt: Because when you look up the word Egypt, if you try to look up Egypt on your own, they're only going to tell you where it's at. It's south, west, east, such and such. They give you the direction of where it's at. They tell you all about it, but they will never tell you what the word actually means. And that's by design that they do that, cuz they know what it's talking about. That's why I said in Exodus the 20th chapter, verse two, it actually gives the definition in the very verse. I am the Lord thy God which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. It's telling you what the word Egypt means right there in the second book. So here in the fifth book, it said that we would go back into that again for breaking God's law. So we fit that. And these no good gutless preachers are making sure that we stay in a dagon degraded state of never returning to our God. That's the outpost that they've set up. And they got their little hoodlum negro pastors and preachers to go along with that to fortify the destruction. So yes, we are at war, brothers and sisters. Y'all understand that? Finish that up in that Bible.

By the way whereof I spake unto thee, thou shalt see it no more again: Exactly the way the Most High said it was going to happen. With the yokes of iron on our necks, our children being taken away from us. The book of Deuteronomy the 28th chapter is basically the movie Roots, Mandingo, all that. That's the script. You want the script to the movie? Read Deuteronomy the 28th chapter. That's it right there. The rape of our women. All of that. Read.

And there: And there, when you get to this new Egypt, this new bondage, which is America, because it is spiritually known as Egypt and it is also spiritually known as Sodom and Gomorrah. So it's telling you crystal clear where the main Egypt is. And that's exactly what's going on, especially in the inner cities of this country. We're going to tap into that thing. Read that statement again.

And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you: And no one shall save us. If you were sold, here go the devil talking about, "So, well, nobody bought you. That means you don't fit the prophecies." Who the hell you think you're talking to? If it says that you were sold, sold is past tense. In order for sold to work, a seller had to take place and a buyer had to take place. So, it's obvious that the word buy at the end of that verse does not mean a transaction. It means no one would save us.

For bondmen and bondwomen: Men in bondage, women in bondage. That's what it means. And no one shall save you, because Christ is the savior. That's how that goes. This is a truth that cannot be denied by anything. Anyone on this planet, anyone. So, you better recognize that, because those of us that don't get it, we going to catch hell by the Most High. He said, "I gave you my truth and you didn't want to stick with it." And you allow somebody to put a bird in your head and some foolish thought and you went flying out somewhere, and you're going to pay for that. So, this is the chance, brothers and sisters, get yourselves right. I'll just say it like that. Let's move on.

The religious outpost: So yes, now speaking about the religious outpost that Deacon Eythan was talking about, Captain Yahn brought this out in his class. Look at this. If we are not the Israelites, why in the world would this setup, this government, this kingdom set up a situation where they have pastors to make sure that we stay in sin? I'm telling you, you can find more churches in the ghetto than anywhere. I'm talking about like every seven doors there's another church. You find five, six witch covens, I mean churches, on every block. When you turn the corner there's seven more. Okay, y'all. All right.

The Religious Instruction of the Negroes in the United States: We going to show that on the board. The Religious Instruction of the Negroes in the United States by Charles Colcock Jones. They wrote a book on it, on how to keep the so-called negroes subversive into submission. And this has gone to all the 12 tribes, because everywhere you go on this planet, all of our people are basically suffering the same kind of oppression. Northern kingdom is suffering the same. Southern kingdom is suffering the same. All over the planet. We're suffering this. That's another image of the book as y'all see there on the screen. Okay, show the last one. This is all the same book. Captain Yahn was reading from this book this morning. So, go back and check that class out, brothers and sisters. I know we just got through watching Deacon Eythan's class, but you can watch that one again, too. But go back and catch the first class because it was deep. It's showing you how it's all set up to keep us in destruction. Excellent information and scriptures. Shout out to Captain and Deacon. All praise to the Lord.

sense.text: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied: This is John the Baptist's father. Come on.

The willful neglect of our shepherds and pastors: So, now we getting ready to get into it. The willful neglect of our shepherds and pastors. That's what today's title is. The willful neglect of our shepherds. They are willfully neglectful of properly shepherding and pastoring the 12 tribes of Israel. It's a willful neglect. They turn their back. They turn their eyes the other way. They're acting in perfect concert with the oppressor to make sure that we stay destroyed. Y'all all right? We going to play this thumbnail in a minute. We see the huge deliberate policies that lead to our despair and hopelessness. These policies guarantee the racial disparities that we can read about almost everywhere we go, in community centers and hospitals and clinics, especially in the inner cities. They all have statistics posted right there on their bulletin boards posted inside. So it is no mystery about what we are being subjected to. I lived in the city. I know New York. I was born in New York. I've been in New York many, many years. I've seen how the city deals. I've seen all that stuff. And y'all gonna find it out in this class here. All right.

Covert: Okay. In order to properly address these disparities, we must face and acknowledge what's right there in front of us as well as seek out what might be considered covert. Because a lot of things, which I'm going to go over today, Lord willing, I'm going to get through it, a lot of things are covert that a lot of people have not really put the pieces together on. But it is because of inquiring minds of leadership. We tend to dig into things that people say you should not be asking about. You understand what I'm saying? There was a little clip that we played before where you had a white man said that if you got a negro on your plantation that's always reading something, that's always trying to learn about things, he's always asking questions, always trying to figure out serious things and stuff like that, he said, "Keep him in the silly mode. Keep them out of asking questions and all that." We ain't that type of people. We going to dig. We going to ask questions. And this particular thing, what I'm about to bring up is because I asked a particular question to a man that was posted inside a door, that was posted inside a building on 97th Street. I'm going to talk about that. And I asked him the question about something that I observed with that particular intersection. And he told me the answer to that. And I've been researching that. Well, I thought about it then, but it really hit me much later on when I really dug into it. I talked about it a little bit on Patient Saints Radio last week, but I'm going to go deeper, Lord willing, today and get deeper into it. So, I ain't going to waste time. We're going to get right into it, y'all.

Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people: So our people are going to be delivered. The psychological and the mental trauma and all of the things that we suffer. The Most High is going to resurrect our people. That's the reason why we are in the ghettos. That's the reason why we're in the train stations. That's the reason why we on the streets. We're talking to our brothers. We're on the streets, at the bus stops. All of that, everywhere. We going to see us. We going to be out there dealing. Come on, read.
And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us: The horn is Christ. Has raised up an horn of salvation. Go ahead.

The thumbnail: Okay. The willful neglect of our shepherds and pastors. Cuz it's a willful neglect. They know what they're doing. They know what they're doing. So, what y'all looking at? Because I'm going to explain the thumbnail a little bit. And y'all are probably thinking, "What the hell does a train have to do with a pastor?" I like that. I like doing things like that. You said, "What does a train have to do with a pastor?" And what does this man sitting in the back? You got a sister holding her baby. Go back to the still cuz we ain't got to show the train no more. I want you to look at the still image. You see her, sister here. She's a single mother. I'm just pointing it out. Move up a little bit. You see basically brother, alcohol addiction. You see the pastor here is so-called praying over people. He ain't doing nothing but sending them to hell with lies. Come over here to the other side. You see the guy here? He's in a straitjacket. Y'all didn't recognize what that was. He's in a mental hospital. That's why I said I want to explain it. He's in a mental hospital because he lost it, because things are going on so crazily in his surrounding and he figured like he has no way out. So they literally break in spirit. People, our brothers and sisters, literally come into the hospitals broken. I've seen this for years, man. People be broken. I'm talking about people that's mothers, fathers, children, you name it. Messed up, and they come in there and they have to get this kind of treatment. Okay, so that's about it. But what we going to go through? We going to go through all of these things.

As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets: That's what the preacher is supposed to be doing. The preachers ain't saying nothing like this at all. The mouth of his holy prophets is not coming out of those cemeteries called churches. They ain't coming out of there. In other words, dead bones in there. Read that verse again.

Two standards of justice: Furthermore, we definitely see that there are two standards of justice, or rather I should say just us. Can you dig it? That's in this country. And the resources that our people need, especially in the inner cities, are not really readily available to our people in the cities. I know this. I've worked in a city for decades. I've seen the disparities on how our people are dealt with in New York particularly. I've seen how our people get treated, especially when they go in the clinics, hospitals, all of that. Seen them in all levels. Our people getting the short end of the stick on all kinds of levels, y'all. All right. So the resources that our people need are not really available to them. So, we're supposed to, as leaders and preachers, if you will, we're supposed to see these disparities and we're supposed to see these injustices and organize the community to solve our own problems. That's what a pastor is supposed to do. That's what a leader is supposed to do. We're supposed to look out and organize the people in righteousness to take them away from the very things that's harming them. The breaking of God's laws that's killing us. Our mothers, unwed mothers, the drugs, the alcohol, all of these things are tearing our people up. And you have leaders that's right there, a church right around the corner that's not even dealing with no level of that at all. Just collecting their tithes, which is not even biblical. That's showing you again, it's an outpost. It's a religious outpost, but I dare to say it's a military outpost, because the actions against us is definitely militaristic.

That we should be saved from our enemies: That's the gospel. That we should be saved from our enemies. Ain't none of these witch covens saying that to the people, brothers and sisters. They don't even know who their enemies are. They're being taken advantage and robbed daily. Even when they're not in church, they're being robbed by a messed up mind that was given to them on Sunday. They get enough dope juice on Sunday to come back home and be doped up the whole week off a doctrine that's against their own selves. They practice self-destruction all week long and get re-energized on Sunday again with more demons. That's what's going on in these so-called churches. Read.

And from the hand of all that hate us: That's the gospel, that we are looking to be redeemed and we're looking to be saved from the hand of our enemies and from the hand of all that hate us. So, don't let anybody tell you that you're in a hate group or anything like that simply because you're asking what I would call racist questions, which there ain't no such thing. If you're questioning the racism you live in, how in the world is that a racist question? Like, you can't ask it. You're the victims of the very thing that's happening to you, but yet you can't ask questions about it. You're feeling the effects of it, but like I said, it's because they taking things from your backside. You don't see them. But when you say, "Hey, somebody just robbed me," they say, "Oh, you're paranoid. You ain't feeling nothing, such and such." You feel it, and you can ask about it. Somebody telling you you can't ask about it. You can ask about it. You can inquire. And that's what real leaders are supposed to do. We're supposed to seek out the things that seem to be covert, the things that nobody's talking about. We going to dig into those things and see how they using those things against our people. Read.

To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant: That's what we looking for, for the Lord to remember his holy covenant with us. But our people need to be told the truth. They need to be waken up to let them know that they themselves are of the covenant of God. These churches are making sure that they stay severed from that understanding. Read.

Covert but yet evident: Okay. So we must face and acknowledge what's right there in front of us as well as seek out what's covert but yet evident in the way that we see our lives going. So although it's covert, we feel the effects of it. Cuz the way war works, it's done in a trickery way where you don't recognize that you're being robbed in the back. That's the reason why people like to do things to you behind your back so you don't see the evil that's being done. And somebody will say to you, "Are you being mistreated?" And you'll say, "No," because you don't see the opponent. But they're busy taking things and robbing you from the back. That's covert. That's because you don't see it. But yet, you feel the effects of it, because of how you acting, how you're behaving, and you're not even able to recognize that it is an absolute result of what's being done to you covertly. Y'all all right? Our enemy's desire is about devouring us secretly. Secretly. That's what I mean when I say they do it behind your back. They hide their hands. And we as pastors, we're pastors, we're shepherds. We're leaders. We have an obligation. We have an obligation. But the pastors that's out there with the churches, they act like nothing is happening. They act like everything is okay as long as they can collect the people's money. That's them. That's not the way leaders are supposed to be. So we have a situation where these churches are set up as willful, neglective religious outposts against our people. Now let's show the thumbnail. Let's get right into it.

That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered: You notice how personal this sounds? You notice how possessive these verses sound? That he may grant unto us, not everybody, unto us. Go ahead. That we being delivered. Not everybody, we being delivered. Let me show how crazy this thing is. How in the world could everybody be the people of God, but yet you asking for deliverance? What in the hell are you asking for deliverance from? If everybody's the people of God, you talking about, I'm looking to be saved. Saved from what? You got to be saved. Just like the Bible said, saved from the hand of those that seek our hurt, to be delivered from our enemies. Like Deuteronomy said, we were sold unto our enemies. That's who we're looking to be saved from. And saved has a D on the end, which means past tense. Ain't nobody saved yet. He that endureth until the end, the same shall be saved. So, we still have work to do. We still have a fight to do, y'all. All right, read on.

Might serve him without fear: That we might serve our God without fear. Read on.

A prophecy about the captive Israelites: Y'all all right? Give me the Bible. Luke chapter 1 verse 67. We're going to read to 75. I'm going to go through this kind of quick because again I'm going to get to the stuff. I ain't going to just ramble through it. A prophecy about the captive Israelites. That's us in these ghettos, in these inner cities. Even in the rural cities, our brothers and sisters are catching hell. Our people are all over the planet Earth catching hell. But I'm going to direct my attention to the city life, so to speak. Y'all all right? A little bit, because what's going on in the city is going on in the rural areas of this society as well. Okay. I remember I was listening to an interview by Chuck D, actually, you know, Public Enemy. They was going out to Rikers Island and he just made, it was a one-liner, and he said what's going on in the prisons is just basically another method of what they do here in society. The different things that people do in society to make money, exchange, you know, the barter systems and all of the things that we do out here, gambling, you know, have a currency, all of that, they have the same kind of system in prison as well. So, everywhere we go, we have that same kind of system, whether it's in prison, whether it's in the society, whether it's in the inner city, or even if it's in the rural south, as they would say. Y'all all right? Okay. Read 67.

In holiness: In holiness. This is what we're looking to do. Do you realize that a church is supposed to be setting this kind of thing up for the people to feel free? Not pseudo freedom. Not the kind of freedom that they really don't really feel free, but they act like they free, knowing damn well they still go back home to the same problems, the same issues. Nothing's changed at all. It's a facade. Read that last verse again. 75.

In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life: That's what we're looking for. We looking to be holy and righteous before the Lord all the days of our lives.

At the shining of thy glittering spear: Give me Habakkuk chapter 3. Read verse 11. Moving on. This is when Christ comes back to save us. He getting ready to destroy our enemies at the sight of that glittering spear, of bombs that he's going to bring, them nuclear weapons. Those heavenly weapons that's going to be amplified by Christ's power to completely make straight riddance of our enemies. And we going to see that destruction while we being delivered. But we got to hold on, brothers. Read on verse 12.

Thou didst thresh the heathen in anger: That's what the Lord going to do. And we're looking for that thing, to be saved from our enemies. These kind of actions need to be done. This is what the gospel is supposed to bring to us. Read on.

Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people: The Lord went forth for the salvation of his people. Not everybody, the Israelites. Come on.

Even for salvation with thine anointed: Thine anointed is the Israelites. That's what the real Christians are. The Israelites. That's what anointed, the anointed people of Christ. Christians, the real Christians. Go ahead.

Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked: The Most High going to put our enemies to death. Come on.

They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: They all going to come together like they're going to take Christ down. All for the fact of trying to keep us in bondage. I want you to really understand what their mobilization to fight against Christ is about. It is to make sure that Christ do not do what he say he going to do, is to relieve his enemies of their slaves. That's what the fight is about. They don't want Christ to redeem us. That's why they lie about Christ. That's what this whole Christianity is about. They tell you that the Christianity is about the Bible by showing you your own Bible, so to speak, but then they lie on it. And you think the lies is the truth. That's deception. Read that statement again.

To scatter me: They came out as a whirlwind to scatter Christ. They say, this is their thought, "You will not save your people. We want to keep the slaves in bondage." That's what Pharaoh said. He said, "The slaves are mine." He said, "Your God can't take them slaves from me. They're mine." The same Pharaoh is Esau practicing the very same thing. They do not want the release of the Israelites to serve their God, like we just read in Luke. That's the whole point. And that's the reason why they keep these military outposts, these religious outposts called churches. I'm calling the church a military outpost. Y'all all right? Read.

Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly: That's the covert action. Their rejoicing. Yeah, I found it. Their rejoicing in their mind was to devour us secretly. Secretly, where you don't recognize it. In the schools, you don't recognize it. They pass certain laws, you don't recognize it. Little things that they do, the politics, all of these things, little nudges here and there designed to keep you in a circle, keep you in a ball of confusion, keep you in a kaleidoscope of confusion. That was a word I used earlier. I had some brothers laughing. Keeping us in a kaleidoscope of confusion where you can't figure out anything, like balls floating in a vacuum. Like Willie Lynch said, they want to keep us in a constant state of confusion where we can't figure out which way is up. Read that statement again.

To devour the poor secretly: Secretly, covertly. But the pastors of God, the leaders of God, the prophets of God, is to take what you think is secret and to expose it and let the brothers and sisters know what they're really up against. Not only that, but to also cultivate them in keeping God's commandments, so that the Lord could have favor on us and bring to pass exactly what we just read. Y'all understand? They don't want a real shepherd coming to you. They don't want a real pastor coming to you. That's what the Bible says. Give me that in Jeremiah 3:15 real quick. We coming back here.

And I will give you pastors according to mine heart: The Lord said, I will give you pastors. I will give you leaders. I will give you shepherds according to my mind. The Lord said. Come on.

Which shall feed you with knowledge: Because they're not being fed the laws of God. That's what the knowledge is. Malachi 2:7. That's what it says there. You ain't got to get it. To feed the people with knowledge, to clean them up. Go ahead.

And understanding: And give them understanding. Wisdom is the principal thing, but in all thy getting of wisdom, get understanding. We have to give the people the understanding as well. That's what's going to straighten you up. That's what straightened me up. That's what's going to continue to straighten me up. That's what's straightening up you sisters. That's what's straightening up you brothers. The rest of our people need that intervention. The rest of our people need that enlightenment. And we have to do that as shepherds.

precepts.why: Because they're not being fed the laws of God. That's what the knowledge is. Malachi 2:7. That's what it says there. You ain't got to get it. To feed the people with knowledge, to clean them up.

sense.text: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters: He mean he going to walk through the nations, their governments, their cities and all that. That's what he's talking about when he says through their horses, through their military, through their great waters, through the nations. The Most High, Christ and the angels are going to walk and tear this whole system up. Go ahead.

When I heard, my belly trembled: When Habakkuk heard, when he was getting this revelation that the Most High was showing him, what he said when he heard what? My belly trembled. He was shaking in his stomach. You know how you can be so nervous and sick? How many of y'all gotten so sick and you feel like throwing up? Really upset, cuz the thoughts be that heavy. Read that again. All of a sudden you got to go to the bathroom. Y'all know what I'm talking about.

My lips quivered at the voice: My lips quiver. And so that was some instant fear. And sometimes we lose this fear. You better get right with it, brothers and sisters. Okay, read that again. At the voice of God that was giving Habakkuk the prophecy. Read on.

Rottenness entered into my bones: That's how fearful it was to hear the Most High speak to him in the spirit. Go ahead.

That I might rest in the day of trouble: Man, that day is going to be so horrible. He said, "I don't even want to be there." Because he's seeing the visions of the total destruction that the Lord is going to bring to redeem his people. He said, "This is too much for me." Go ahead.

When he cometh up unto the people: When Christ cometh up to the enemies, listen what he going to do.

He will invade them with his troops: That's what he's coming with. Those 200 million angels. I think that's a number. It says thousands and thousands ministered unto him. I got to do the math to figure out how many angels Christ is coming back with. 200 million. One angel's eyes is 10,000 times brighter than the sun. Imagine what 200 million of them going to do. Y'all all right? When that alarm go off, that's when they're going to be running. Okay. He shall invade them with his chariots. That's what that's talking about, y'all. All right. So, while we feed God's people, the Israelites, we know that our God is coming with vengeance and deliverance.
Give the king thy judgments, O God: Give me Psalm 72. We coming on down the line. Psalm 72, give me verse 1 to 4.

He shall judge thy people with righteousness: The Most High is going to judge his people. So, we better be in the right space when Christ comes back. We better be getting ourselves prepared today. Right now. Go ahead. This ain't the time to be fainting. No, this ain't the time. The Most High is bringing it down. Read.

Tell the truth to our people about who they are: We must tell the truth to our people about who they are and what they mean to the enemy. Let me say that again. We must teach our people the truth and we must show them their relation to the enemy. Our people think that they are walking through the tulips. You got to recognize what your existence mean to the enemy. The mere fact that we're able to do anything for ourselves is a detriment, is a nightmare to an enemy. Do we really understand what it means to be a nemesis to someone, or them being a nemesis to us? That means everything that we do in the positiveness, it directly affects their power over us. That's what it means to be an enemy in that regard. So we need to make sure that our people know that they are targets of a plot to keep them in dominance, at the expense of yourselves, the expense of your babies, your husbands, your wives, and your children. They prosper off of the decadence of our people. We need to understand that. And you don't need to be wishy-washy when it comes to asking questions about why certain aspects of your reality is this way or that way. No one should ever make you feel like you can't ask that question. The hell with them. Y'all understand that? So, I'm saying those things so you can get the right thought in your mind.

Where is this organizing going to come from: Okay. Where is this organizing going to come from? It's going to come through the Israelites, meaning us. It's not going to come through your willfully blind pastors. It's not. They're not looking to organize our people at all. Show me the billboard, brothers. This is where it's going to come from. The Bible has the solution to our people's problems. Man, I love that logo. The Bishop came up with this. We go way back in the old school. We had the original show called The Bible, the Book of Our Fathers. And that was the slogan that he had put at the back. And I love it because it makes perfect sense. The Bible has the solution to our people's problems. Y'all all right? But notice now, y'all might not recognize where this is. This is in New York. This is 241st Street and White Plains Road. That's where the number two train ends, for those of you who are from New York. Okay. That's our billboard that we put up there. That's a train station. That's an actual train station up there, y'all. All right. That's not too far from the Mount Vernon school, just for y'all to know. Mount Vernon is on the border of the Bronx. It's like the Wakefield section of the Bronx. Okay. So, that's what we talking about here.

What main responsibilities do we have: So, with that being said, how do we as leaders, how do we as pastors and shepherds make sense of all this mess? What main responsibilities do we have? And what we must do in order to serve our people? Notice I says serve our people. We have an obligation to serve the people. Y'all understand me? Our mission is to know the state of the flock, find out where we're deficient at, and to bring the solutions to our people's problems. Hence the Bible, the book of our fathers. Y'all know that's our slogan, right? So all praise to the Most High.

Get our minds right first: I remember watching a clip from Braveheart, and a little boy said, "I want to go to war with you." Braveheart was about black people, by the way. But the little boy whose father was killed in war, his uncle took him in. And the little boy said, "I want to go to war, too." He little now. And he's showing, he said, "I can do this. I can do that." And uncle said, "Listen, put the sword down." He said, "First, learn how to use this and it will teach you how to use this." So the Lord wants us to get our minds right first before you get the power, so that you will know what to do with the power. Y'all understand? So we have an obligation to fix ourselves now. Y'all understand that? Just making that point. That's why they put guns all over the dag on ghetto. They got so many gun laws in New York, when there's not a nook in New York that don't have at least two or three of them, right? They're all over the damn place. You understand? And they got the toughest gun laws all over the place. But my point is, they allow them to have it to make criminals out of them, because what are they going to do? They ain't going to do nothing but bring havoc to their own people, bring havoc to their own neighborhoods and all of that. I'm checking out reports, somebody just this morning in the Bronx got killed just going to school this morning for nothing. So, I'm just showing you wild and crazy. So, I'm going just leave that alone. I'm certain that you're going to hear those things on other outlets, but I'm going to move on with my lesson.

He shall save the children of the needy: He going to save all our people that's in total despair in these inner cities, in the rural countries, all over the planet earth. The Most High is going to have mercy, like he said in Isaiah the 14th chapter. For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob. We need mercy, brothers and sisters. Okay, read that statement again.

And shall break in pieces the oppressor: He shall break in pieces the oppressor. He shall break in pieces our oppressors. That's why it said that again in Isaiah 14. And we shall rule over our oppressors, because their power is going to be broken. They ain't going to have any power to stop us. The Most High is going to break them down. That's why he said it in that same chapter. For the Lord has broken the staff of the wicked. He going to break them, gonna break that power down. They're not gonna have any power to rise up to do anything against the righteousness that's gonna come from Jacob in that day, all 12 tribes of Israel.

We must wake our people up out of sleep: We must wake our people up out of sleep. They must be made aware of the social plots and traps designed to enslave and destroy the next generation of our people, which includes our babies, our children, and our adults, men and women. We must enlighten our people to unite and organize themselves into an exceeding army of men who are about keeping God's commandments. I ain't talking about picking up weapons and doing no craziness. That ain't what I'm talking about. A disciplined army of men who will guide his household, who will guide his nation, who will teach righteousness to his children, his wives, his daughters. That's the army that the Lord is looking for. Don't worry about the power and the weapons yet. The Lord going to bring that. Right now, he needs us to get our mind right.

The beginning of organization: But I wanted to show you that because this is the beginning of organization. This is the beginning of cleaning our brothers, and hence our sisters and children, up. You got to think about it. All those brothers that you see there, the enemy wanted to make sure that they was into selling drugs, being evil fathers, being murderers. You got to look at it. Look at all those men. And the enemy's gritting their teeth. When they see this, they said, "Damn, that's another potential drug dealer that we could have had. That's a potential robber that we could have had. That's a potential man that we could have had that's making babies all over the place and ain't taking care of nothing." And all that's been taken away from them because these brothers got themselves right. The enemy hates this. Y'all understand that? Just making that point.

sense.text:
Arise, shine; for thy light is come: Give me Isaiah chapter 60 verse 1 and 2. We moving on down the line. This is the message that we're telling our brothers and sisters right there in the ghettos. Right there in New York City, right there in North Carolina, everywhere we go, it is time for our brothers and sisters to wake the hell up. We know that there's plots out there that's trying to kill our people. But our objective is, to hell with all of them. We going to get this word to you anyway. You ain't stopping this. Read.

And the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee: And the glory of the Lord, it is time for you to wake up. That's what Isaiah 13 is talking about. It's time for you to wake out of sleep. Come on.

But the Lord shall arise upon thee: The Lord is going to make a miracle. He's going to rise upon us in that supreme darkness and he going to wake us up. And then our enemy say, "How in the world did you find this out? How in the world did y'all find out these secrets? How did y'all find this out?" They're bewildered and baffled and they can't stop nothing. You want to be on the winning team, brothers and sisters. You ain't going to lose on this side. Ain't nothing out there but death. You better come on in here. Come on in for the big win, huh? Y'all all right? Read on.

For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth: So all the people on this planet earth is in darkness, because the Bible tells you that the earth is given into the hand of the wicked. And also in Proverbs 29, the second verse, it says, "When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice, but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn." So the whole earth is mourning in ignorance, is mourning in debauchery. They're in a vortex of spiritual destruction, in a kaleidoscope of confusion. I keep using that word, right? We're in a vortex of complete madness. And our enemies love it that way. Gross darkness is us. But the people are in darkness. Read that again.

And gross darkness the people: The people is Israel. We are in the supreme darkness. We are in a darkness like the Bible says in Deuteronomy. It says that we shall grope at noonday as a blind man gropeth in the darkness. Look at that. Just think about that verse there. I ain't got to turn. I'mma explain it. We shall grope around, like feeling for walls, when the sun is 12:00 in the sky. I'm showing you the condition of our particular blindness as opposed to everybody else's blindness. It says, "Darkness shall cover the earth, but gross darkness is upon us." And we fit what Deuteronomy 28 says. It says that we shall grope at noonday, groping around trying to feel our way, trying to feel the walls on which way to walk. We're like children in a foreign country walking, and we don't recognize that the signs are saying the bridge is out, electric wire here. We don't see the pitfalls because we can't read the language. That's how we are spiritually.

As the blind gropeth in darkness: So, here we are. We're like a blind man in the darkness, but yet it's 12:00 noon where the sun is straight up. It says that thou shalt grope at noonday the same way as a blind man gropeth in the dark. A blind man can't see whether it's light or dark. The Lord is saying, "But your darkness is worse than that." A man with sight in a dark room can't see. The Lord said that our blindness is worse than that. Our blindness is that we're blind and plus we're in a dark room, but yet it's 12:00 outside. I want you to get that. That's the reason why I'm explaining it that way. That's how messed up our people are. And these preachers ain't doing nothing to help our people. And they're sitting in there robbing the people and ain't telling them nothing. All these lying pastors. Willful, willful neglect. And they just watching our people go to hell in a hand basket. Don't even give a damn. Read.

And his glory shall be seen upon thee: The glory of God will be seen on you. And that's exactly what the people see when they see us in the streets. They're saying, "We know that these are not no ordinary so-called negroes." They see how we move. They see how we stand. They see how we march. They see how we deal, what we set up, how we deal with each other in our departments, how we deal in the organization, how we're cleaning up men, cleaning up women, all by the power of the Lord. They see this, and you know damn well that they ain't helping us. They ain't giving us no breaks for us to do these things. We're doing this despite their efforts to destroy us. So God has got to be with us, brothers. God has got to be with us, sisters.

We are in a darkness like the Bible says in Deuteronomy. It says that we shall grope at noonday as a blind man gropeth in the darkness. I'm showing you the condition of our particular blindness as opposed to everybody else's blindness. Our blindness is that we're blind and plus we're in a dark room, but yet it's 12:00 outside.

sense.text:
For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep: Give me Isaiah 29 verse 10. We got to wake our people up, brothers. For the Lord has poured out upon us the spirit of deep sleep. Come on.

And hath closed your eyes: And have closed our eyes. Go ahead.

The prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered: That's the reason why these pastors can't do anything, because they're wicked as hell. And the spirit of righteousness is not going to dwell in a wicked soul. So they ain't never going to wake up if they don't come out of that foolishness. Come on, read.

And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed: They're in church and you got the people in the church, and they don't even recognize that the book that they're reading is actually about the people that's in front of them. But whenever they come and ask the pastor about the condition that's going on right there in the Bronx, right there in Harlem, right there in Charlotte, right there in Augusta, right there in Watts, right there in Los Angeles, right there in Chicago. They're saying, "Why are these issues in Philly? Why these issues and these things happening to us?" These no good, lying, evil preachers can't even go inside the Bible and show them what the Bible is talking about in reference to them. Read that statement again.

And the vision of all: And the vision of all, what's being seen by everybody. Go ahead.

Is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed: You might as well be saying the Bible is sealed off to me, because I don't see what you're asking me. That's some stuff there. The people don't even know the book that's sitting there. Well, supposedly, because a lot of these churches don't even have Bibles in them. I can't even understand that foolishness, that Pastor Pam foolishness. They all in the damn dark. What the hell is that? What kind of Bible are they reading? They ain't reading no Bible at all. The Bible don't even glow in the dark. They don't have nothing at all. That's why when we went out there, we opened the Bible up to them. They probably went blind. Man, they be like, "Oh," you know, like somebody turn the light on and your eyes just... They probably never seen that before. Man, that was some wicked boy. There was some demons on there. Great is Diana. That's what they were saying when we would come around the corner. That's what they were basically saying. Wow.

Which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot: He don't literally say that. He tells you, "Have you been redeemed? Have you been baptized?" That's what he do to you, huh? That's what he do to you. Ain't answer nothing.

One that is learned: The one that is learned is the one that went to cemetery school. I mean seminary school. I keep getting that mixed up. He went to the graveyard university where they buried him in a crooked theology. That's what happened to him. Read that again. Learned pastor. So-called learned pastor.

And he saith, I cannot: Because the Most High ain't dealing with him. That's the point there. Go ahead.

For it is sealed: For it is sealed. He really can't see.

And he saith, I am not learned: Because he didn't go to cemetery school. Go ahead.

And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: That's the storefront preacher. That's the one that's got a little storefront hole in the wall. Got some pews. Got some drums, and the one thing that he will have in there is that damn Hammond organ. He'll have that in there. That Hammond organ is designed to stir them demons up. Hit that tone wheel and that thing start wobbling. That tambourine start going and all of a sudden you feel the goosebumps. You don't know what the hell happened to you. You catch them coming out, say, "Hey man, how was service?" "I don't know, but it sure was good." That Hammond organ, man, that thing cost like $10,000. Them damn organs is not cheap. The dag on pews is uncomfortable. The Bibles ain't in no good condition or nothing. But that dag on Hammond organ, that box they got in there, is oiled down with Pledge. That thing work.

That box: Y'all need to do some research on that box, by the way. No, no, no. I'mma get off that. Y'all need to just look it up and look up the psychological effects of what that do to the people. There's literal information on it. The psychological effect of the Hammond organ. You can literally put it in there like that and it'll tell you all kind of things. So the preacher said, "We ain't going to get no tithe money till we get that box in here. And if the wrong person sit down on that organ and he ain't hitting them notes right, they firing him." They said, "Listen, you got to know how to hit the demonic chords to get the people to do their thing." I'm telling you, I've seen it. They said, "The money ain't coming in here, right? Hey, get so and so, call him in. What do you mean he ain't here today? Call him and tell him get in and sit on that seat and hit them dag on notes." And the next thing you know the money start rolling. We've seen this. We've seen this. I was a witness of, a victim of this thing. Me and the brothers, we was in Liberia and we've seen and felt the effects of that thing, man. I said, "Yo, we got to get the hell out of here before they kill us." We were looking for the escape door in the back. It's a funny story. Y'all might hear us talk about it one day. But let me get back to what I was saying. Where am I at?

But have removed their heart far from me: The reason why they removed their heart far from the Lord, because they're not being taught. That's why it says that in Isaiah 5. Give me that real quick. 5, 13 to 14. This is the reason why the people ain't responding right when it comes to this Bible, because the preachers that's leading them is destroying them.

Therefore my people are gone into captivity: My people are going into captivity. That's the Israelites. Go ahead.

Because they have no knowledge: Because the preachers are supposed to be teaching them the laws and the commandments of God. That's what the knowledge is, through Christ. Come on.

And their honourable men: And the honorable men are these pastors, are these shepherds, or these preachers. They're supposed to be the honorable men in the congregation. They're the ones supposed to be teaching the people. And the honorable men are what?

Are famished: Meaning that they're empty of God's truth. That's why it says they themselves can't even answer the people's questions. It says the book is delivered to one that is learned and he says I cannot, because it's sealed, because it's not in him. Y'all understand that? That's why in here it's saying that they are famished, meaning empty. Don't have God's commandments. They don't have the spirit of God in them. They can't wake up nothing. Read.

And their multitude dried up with thirst: And the multitude of the people that's listening to these empty pastors, they're dried up with thirst. Why? Because they're not being fed by the preacher that's supposed to be feeding them. So they're dried up with thirst because the preachers are not even feeding them. So the whole church is in a mess. That's what's all over the city. Go ahead.

Therefore hell hath enlarged herself: Therefore, meaning because of those conditions that we just read. Therefore, what? Our condition of hell has gotten worse. That's what we're going to show you coming up. The condition of our people have gotten worse. That's what the hell is. Crack, unwed mothers, crime, sickness, mental sicknesses, disease, all of these things is happening as a result. Read.

And opened her mouth without measure: And has opened her mouth, meaning the mouth of hell has gotten so bad, it seemed like we ain't never going to come out of it. And a lot of our people have given up. A lot of our people are losing it, going crazy, being admitted into hospitals, signing themselves out to crime, criminal activity, and throwing their lives away literally, and ended up in jail, and finding out in prison that all of the people that's in jail with him look just like him. And they all took a similar path to get there. They all met in the damn jail. They all met in the psych ward. They all met in the hospital and didn't even know each other before they got there. They all met in the prison because they don't see the traps that led them there. Read that last statement again.

And their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it: All of what our people are about is going to descend into destruction. The vortex of destruction. Okay. Now, go back to Isaiah 29 and read the next verse.

But have removed their heart far from me: Because the preachers is making sure that the heart, the mind of the people is far removed from God. That's the reason why those religious outposts are in our cities, to make sure that the people stay disconnected from God. Go ahead. They're literally, in my mind, they're seen as garrisons. I don't see them as righteous at all. Read.

And their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men: The only thing that they teach in these churches is to fear white people. That's what these pastors do, is to make the people fear white people. Okay. Is that it? There's some more. Read on.

If you're reading this, this nation needs you: And this is what I was talking about with this statement here. If you're reading this, this nation needs you. So what we doing in IUIC, we organize the brothers and sisters to become more designed as a nation. Like I was talking about when we just had our tabernacles, setting up the stewardship program is designed as an infrastructural framework that is to facilitate all necessary functions and needs by bringing resources, talents, trades, and professions, by making them accessible to those in our nation who are in need. So that's what we do. We organize. We set things in order. That's what this is about. So we organize the talents, we organize the resources. You understand? That's what a church is supposed to do. That's what a pastor is supposed to do. Organize the people so that we can learn how to operate as a nation. And that's why I was talking about that in terms of tabernacles. We learn how to be a nation. We learn how to be an organized nation. Y'all understand, it's on the back of our shirts. Well, we got to mean that. An organized nation, y'all.

I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people: So what are we talking about? The marvelous work. What is the marvelous work? Put the next slide up there. This is just part of it. If you're reading this, your nation needs you. This is really an internal thing. You got to be inside the congregation to even know where this thing will lead you. So, I'm going just say that and just keep on speaking. But the marvelous work began in 2003 with IUIC. We've been on a mission to take this gospel to levels never seen before since the 60s. And this marvelous work will continue through Christ's mighty salvation. And that will be the amazement by all our enemies when they see how the Lord is going to resurrect us from this mental and spiritual death. So the marvelous work is actually beginning now.

A marvellous work and a wonder: All right. So with the beginning stages of this marvelous work, the Lord will assist us in reaching his ultimate task of delivering us from the hand of our enemies. So it began in 2003 with the inception of IUIC. Bishop Nathanyel heads IUIC, and we as the supporting bishops work along with him, along with the deacons, the captains and so forth. But this mission is Christ's mission. So, just want to put that out there, right?

Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD: We're getting ready to get into it now. So that's what I'm dealing with. Woe be unto our enemies who did secret things to destroy us secretly. Y'all, it's coming. Y'all going to get it. To destroy us secretly. And we don't even see it. But inquisitive minds wanted to know. And I'm not the only one. I'm just speaking about what I experienced. Y'all all right? Read.

And their works are in the dark: They said that their works are in the dark. What they did, they said that nobody's going to find out what we did and how we're prospering off of what we've done to bring our slaves to permanent demise. Go ahead.

And they say, Who seeth us?: That's what they say. Who see what we did? Who see that we set up in the colleges, for an example, the universities where they had different experiments? Those experiments was about how they can best use your own mind to work against your own progress. Stanley Milgram's obedience. Y'all think it's about what happened in Nazi Germany. No, it was about training us to be obedient to what you later on would call authority. The Stanford prison experiment was another one that was about how we get certain roles and we get uppity and we look down on our brothers. The prison where they had one side to be prisoners and the other side to be the guards, and they all buddies, and the damn experiment went so wild they had to stop it, because they got so carried away. People got so bigheaded because of their position that they had. Well, they know that if they deprive us of all kinds of things, the moment they give you a little bit of job here, a little such and such, all of a sudden, nobody can't tell you nothing. That's the same situation.

Who knoweth us?: Y'all understand that everything that they do on this earth is about subduing you. Let me say that again. Don't even think for a moment that there's not anything that's being done anywhere that the ultimate goal is to find a way to subdue you, because we are God's people. You must understand that. So that was obedience, Stanley Milgram's, the prison experiment, and there was another one that I was trying to think, I couldn't remember. Stanford. I said the Stanford, right? Stanford one. All right. Y'all get it. Y'all can look these things up. Even though they'll tell you other things, talking about it was about the authority and Hitler and all that. Skinner box with B. F. Skinner. All of these things. And another one is behavioral sink. They got a whole lot of things. And it was all really about how to keep us subdued, even though they're not telling you that. That's why it says here that they say, "Who seeth us? Who knoweth us?" That's really about you. Read on.

Surely your turning of things upside down: They think they got it on lock. They think that we are done, permanently done. But surely how they lied and turned everything upside down. What it say?

Shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: The Lord could easily fix his nation back up. He's going to esteem us and clean us up just like you would do with clay. You made it into one vessel. You can break it down and build it and make it something that you adore. It's easy. That's how the Lord's going to deal with us. He going to clean us up. Read on.

Or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?: So we cannot change how God is going to do things. So we don't have to question what the Lord going to do. The Most High is going to mold us back into the way we need to be. And that's a beautiful thing to behold and a beautiful thing to know.

No such thing as racist questions: We must be extremely mindful that there is no such thing as racist questions. I'm in it now. No such thing as racist questions. Give me the next screenshot. Now I'm going to show you something. When I say there's no such thing as racist questions, I had a question about something when I was living in New York, y'all. All right. I've been there many years. I used to work downtown. There was an electronic store that I used to work on, on Fifth Avenue. And I used to ride the 7th Avenue line. That's the IRT number two. And when the train got to 96th Street, those who are from New York, you're going to know what I'm talking about. Y'all all going to recognize this. The next stop after 96th Street on the IRT is 110th Street, where it has to go around that sharp turn underground and it comes out on 110th Street. The Bobby Womack song, right? Across 110th Street. Y'all know about that, right? Huh? Going back now. But at the 96th Street train station, whether you on the number one, whether you're on the number two train, whether you're on the four train, you got the other side, too, the four, five, and the six. 96th Street was the street where you just seen a demographic change right there on the train.

When you got to 96th Street: Who in here is from New York? Hands up so I can see you. How many of y'all know what I'm talking about? You ever rode the train? When you got to 96th Street, you see all the … get off. All the white folks get off. I had a question about that. Y'all all right? I think I was like 20. It was in the '80s. But it never stopped. It never stopped. Come on. Read. Well, let me read this. This is my question. Now I said racist question because there's no such thing as a racist question. This is an honest question. "Oh, you're a racist for asking that question." No, I ain't, because this is what I experienced. Y'all understand what I'm saying? This is me writing this and waiting for an AI response. So, that's what's happening here. This is my writing. This is my question.
